units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>לא׳ בן הדימה</he> (Var. <he>לאר׳ כן</he>) a gloss inserted in the text, and which read <he>לאו דוקא אלא כן הדימם</he> ‘not to be taken literally’ (that the Divine Word kissed every Israelite &c.), ‘but he made them so imagine’.
